questions.markdown:
A silicon diode is forward biased by $0.65\,\text{V}$, and has a reverse saturation current of $12\,\text{nA}$ at $20^\circ\text{C}$.

Calculate,

i) Diode current.

ii) Static and Dynamic resistance.

iii) Diode current when the temperature rises to $100^\circ\text{C}$.
Draw V-I characteristics of the 'Si' diode. Explain the different types of breakdowns that can occur in a PN junction diode.

questions.markdown: Explain the operation of a center-tapped Full Wave Rectifier with a neat circuit diagram and waveforms. Derive the equation for $V_{dc}$, $V_{rms}$ and efficiency considering ideal diodes.

A half-wave rectifier with a capacitor filter is supplied from a transformer having a peak secondary voltage of $20\,\text{V}$ and frequency $50\,\text{Hz}$. The load resistance is $560\,\Omega$ and the capacitor used is $1000\,\mu\text{F}$. Calculate ripple factor and dc output voltage. Draw the filtered output and label peak and dc value.

Draw the circuit of a Zener voltage regulator. The Zener diode in a regulator circuit has a breakdown voltage of $15\,\text{V}$, a minimum current of $1\,\text{mA}$, and a power rating of $0.5\,\text{W}$. The series resistance connected in the circuit is $1\,\text{k}\Omega$. If the input voltage applied is $40\,\text{V}$, find the range of load resistance that can be connected to prevent the Zener diode from being destroyed.

i) With the help of a truth table, obtain the Boolean expression for a 4:1 Multiplexer and implement it using basic gates.

ii) Perform $(19.25)_{10} - (10.75)_{10}$ using 2's complement method.

Define CMRR for an OPAMP. When the voltage applied to the non-inverting terminal, $V_1$ is $0.25\,\text{mV}$ and the voltage applied to the inverting terminal, $V_2$ is $-0.25\,\text{mV}$, the output voltage of the OPAMP is $4\,\text{V}$. For the same OPAMP, when $V_1 = V_2 = 0.5\,\text{mV}$, the output voltage is $6\,\text{mV}$. Calculate CMRR.
With a neat circuit diagram and relevant waveforms, explain the working of a square wave generator.
A $(7,4)$ bit Hamming code received is $0011101(P_1P_2D_3P_4D_5D_6D_7)$, considering even parity. Check for errors in the received code and if there is an error, write the corrected code.
With a neat circuit diagram and truth table, explain the working of 4:1 multiplexer using basic gates.
Design a 2-bit Ripple down counter using negative edge triggered JK Flipflop. Draw the timing for the same.

An audio signal $20\sin(2\pi 100t)$ amplitude modulates a carrier of $40\sin(2\pi 200\times 10^3 t)$. Find (a) modulation index (b) Sideband frequencies (c) Bandwidth (d) Amplitude of each side band components.
For the given binary data 1101 sketch the ASK, FSK and PSK waveforms.
State the sampling theorem. For an analog signal, $x(t) = 10\cos 200\pi t + 2\sin 300\pi t - \cos 100\pi t$. Determine the minimum sampling rate required to reconstruct the signal.
